list.comment:
Add password change and success templates
Implemented `password_change.html` and `password_change_done.html` to complete the password update workflow. Adjusted view logic in `views.py` and updated related settings for proper template rendering and navigation. These changes enhance user experience with styled templates and improved functionality.

Add features for student dashboard and database migrations.
Introduced `get_student_dashboard_data` service to aggregate dashboard data like schedule, grades, attendance, and assignments. Created initial migrations for professor models including `Note` and `LectureMaterial` for improved functionality. Updated URLs, templates, and added custom template tags for dynamic dashboard UI and features.

Improve student dashboard with grades features and styling
Refactored `get_student_dashboard_data` to use a proper weekday mapping for schedule retrieval. Introduced a new `notes_view` to manage student grade details with distribution and trends. Updated templates, URLs, and added styling for grades and dashboard UI, including new filtering and Chart.js integration.

Refactor scheduling, add materials view, and improve UI
Renamed schedule view and URLs, introduced materials view, and refined course and notes templates. Updated styles for better usability and added search functionality for materials and grades.

Add logout button and improve course and assignment UI
Added a logout button to the course header for better UX. Removed "Sunday" from the weekday mapping. Improved styling and structure for course and assignment templates, including better responsive design, updated CSS classes, and enhanced layout formatting.

Improve UI/UX and add dynamic filtering for notes and courses
Enhanced templates by adding dynamic filters for courses and notes to improve usability. Updated sidebar links and refined the sidebar's display logic. Applied @login_required across key views and optimized data handling for student selection in the grading interface.

Update dashboard to replace average grade with absence count
Replaced the display of average grade with the count of absences for students in both the backend and frontend. Updated templates and services to reflect the new metric, ensuring consistent functionality and accurate data presentation.

Fix missing comma in context dictionary in prof/views.py
Added a missing comma in the context dictionary to ensure proper key-value mapping. This resolves potential errors or incorrect rendering in the related view.

Update SDK and localize login page to French
Upgraded the project environment to Python 3.13 and updated related settings in `.idea` configuration files. Localized text in `login.html` to French, improving accessibility for French-speaking users.

Add password change and success templates
Implemented `password_change.html` and `password_change_done.html` for a complete password update workflow. Included styled templates, form handling, and responsive behavior to improve user experience.
